clause_ii.reason: The configured four chronological frames cover 500 ms and show the camera coordinate/map and the beam's changing projection in the canvas. Combined with the held direction in I_t, a bounded-window policy can release before the visible source leaves the usable frustum and then capture it.

clause_iii.reason: Choose H_t during a held forward segment while the beam is visibly in the capture frustum. Releasing the hold immediately preserves that capture opportunity; with no new action for 500 ms, tickMove advances the camera about 1.175 m and can carry the beam out of the frustum, so the same release has lower value and requires recovery. Success remains possible, and the loss is geometric state evolution rather than a deadline.

clause_i.reason: For D=held navigation and Delta=500 ms, histories with the same action history can have different lane_y, source_side, pit choices, and wall location. An observation-free q(I_t) cannot choose the timely navigation release and capture continuation for every success-preserving history.

clause_ii.reason: The configured four chronological frames cover 500 ms and show the camera coordinate/map and the source's changing projection in the canvas. Combined with the held direction in I_t, a bounded-window policy can release before the visible source leaves the usable frustum and then capture it.

clause_iii.reason: Choose H_t during a held forward segment while the beam is visibly in the capture frustum. Releasing the hold immediately preserves that capture opportunity; with no new action for 500 ms, tickMove advances the camera about 1.175 m and can carry the beam out of the frustum, so the same release has lower value and requires recovery. Success remains possible, and the loss is geometric state evolution rather than a deadline.
